title: Uniqueness of an element of fixed rank
statement: Let $l$ be a finite list in a linearly ordered set and let $k$ be a natural number. If $y$ and $z$ both occur in $l$, with fewer than $k$ entries strictly below each and at least $k$ entries at most each, then $y=z$.
